entries.rationale: Implemented installation settings with live policy actions, version-bound edits and save failure/conflict states. Owner decision 2026-10-12 authorizes eight independently repository-authored installation-settings-v2 design derivatives and one further capture/comparison after source/reference review. Listed genuine Paper frame IDs identify original design ancestry, not new Paper artboards or exports; scoring uses the declared derivative JSX and versioned reference paths. All84 selection, full frames, strict schema and inclusive0.95 remain mandatory. Prebound references await rendering/hash finalization; no F2 pass or Phase5 completion is claimed. Owner decision 2026-10-14 ("go with option 1, add v3 references"): E16 added Licence and Audit log to the installation section nav, so the four desktop frames are re-rendered as repository-authored installation-settings-v3 successors with the real four-item nav; v2 references and provenance stay intact, phone frames stay on v2, threshold unchanged at 0.95.
Installation administrators: E16 route not built yet. Reference renders exist; scoring starts when the route ships and the entry becomes baselined.

Organization access page. The page ships at /settings/organization/access (route settings-organization-access) and renders the same component through the development alias /__fixtures__/organization/access for Paper capture. The cases stay planned because baselining them changes candidate.route in entitlements-baselines.json, which compare-paper.mjs blocks without a refreshed immutable Paper source identity, and because the frames contradict each other (see settings-organization-access). The seat-banner frames also draw the invite form without its role selector and send button, a dark desktop layout that differs from the light one, and a form-only phone layout. Phone captures are clipped to the frame height, so phone scores measure pixels, not page height. Measured locally 2026-10-22 (planned cases, not gated), whole frame: access-page phone members light 0.343, members dark 0.246, empty 0.296, error 0.308, loading 0.216; seat-banner phone 0.000 (surface); desktop members light 0.959, members dark 0.940, empty 0.824, error 0.806, loading 0.736. Scored from the Access heading down with the heading aligned, the phone page itself reads error 1.000, loading 1.000, empty 0.928 (the New service account action the empty card must offer) and members light 0.956 down to the accounts section, whose New service account and New token actions Paper does not draw; members dark draws another rhythm than members light. Every phone frame draws a settings sub-header (back to Settings, Platform team with role) that neither the organization nor the installation shell has, and the status frames put the heading 16px lower than the members frame. For installation the owner chose repository-authored phone derivatives without that sub-header (2026-10-12); the organization frames need the same owner decision, or a shell change, before any whole phone frame can reach 0.95.

Custom roles. The page ships at /settings/organization/roles (route settings-organization-roles); no candidate fixture renders it at this path for Paper capture yet, so the cases stay planned and no golden is claimed. Scoring starts when a capture alias exists and the entry becomes baselined.
Audit log: E16 route not built yet. Reference renders exist; scoring starts when the route ships and the entry becomes baselined.

Cases stay planned, as for organization-access, because baselining them changes candidate.route in entitlements-baselines.json, which compare-paper.mjs blocks without a refreshed immutable Paper source identity. Reference renders exist; scoring starts when the entry becomes baselined.
SCIM connection and token: E16 route not built yet. Reference renders exist; scoring starts when the route ships and the entry becomes baselined.

Production and the 22 DEV fixture candidate cases share TaskSessionView, TaskRunSectionView, TaskRunStreamView and AppLayout with ArtifactPane. Fixtures supply deterministic authored data; production supplies API state and operational controls. The standard artifacts manifest comparison scores whole artboards at >=0.95 per case. Production browser suites and PostgreSQL-backed seeded acceptance separately prove reconnect, replay, outcomes and archive recovery. Fixture scores do not claim all-state live API parity. E06 (#161, #128) retired the task-detail debt entry, whose route id this entry replaced: its E-0 HU-0/P6-0 planning frames are superseded by native Paper p-18-0 task-conversation frames (2IBL-0, 2IFZ-0, 2J3V-0, 2IK1-0, 2IO3-0, 2IS5-0, 2IW7-0), scored on this path by the 7 enterprise manifest cases task-conversation.* against /__fixtures__/work/conversation/$state, listed under additionalManifests and checked like the artifacts cases. The cases cover the default state (light and dark desktop, light phone) and the plan-review, question, empty and conflict states (light desktop). Evidence: .omo/evidence/paper2-final/.

Organization Integrations page (#133): the route every GitHub connection callback returns to. Connect GitHub (install then authorize), a pending connection's repository selection and Enable, a Check showing health and capabilities, and a message for every connection outcome. integration-mocks-v2 depicts a separate multi-route wizard (/integrations/github/connect/*, connection detail and settings) rather than this settings route the server redirects to, so no frame maps to it and none is invented. Built from the settings pattern (SettingsContent, SettingsSection, StatusBadge, Checkbox, DescriptionList, CapabilityList, AlertBanner). No-mock follows the owner-approved installation-integrations precedent of 2026-10-28; Paper parity stays unscored until a mock maps here.

Organization Access page (E16 phase 13): members with scoped roles, invitations, service accounts and tokens, connected clients. The page renders through the AccessSettings template. Its Paper frames stay owned by the planned organization-access entry (path /organization/access) and are scored locally, not in CI, through the development alias /__fixtures__/organization/access and the access capture recipe in packages/ui/scripts/capture-enterprise.mjs (2026-10-21, compare-paper.mjs --manifest entitlements with those cases temporarily ledgered baselined): members light desktop 0.9586 (passes the 0.95 floor), members dark desktop 0.9395, empty 0.8239 (0.8420 before the empty card gained New service account), error 0.8057, loading 0.7356 as whole frames. Scored on the main content area alone, empty, error, loading and members dark are 0.9878, 1.0, 1.0 and 0.9579. The whole-frame shortfall is the Paper shell, which the frames disagree on (empty, error and loading draw a 38px section-nav pitch and no account actions; members draws 40px and a 32px account circle; the dark members frame draws no account circle). Phone frames are scored with the capture clipped to the frame; their numbers and the shell gap are in the organization-access entry. Binding the cases needs a refreshed Paper source identity and an owner decision on which shell is authoritative, so no golden is claimed here.

The page is read only so far; the mock's Publish rules, Configure and Preview impact actions arrive with the editing slices of #65.

Repository effective rules page (#65 PR3): the rules in force for one repository, rule by rule, with where each came from (inherited, locked by the organization, repository override, repository only), what Bakery can and cannot check, and the provider branch protection that Bakery does not read (always Unknown). Paper page 61 draws no repository frame this page could be scored against, and design-ux's UX design comment on #65 (section E) is the reference; the screen reads the server's effective projection and keeps no state of its own.

Its Paper frames stay owned by the planned organization-sso entry (path /organization/sso) and are captured through the development alias /__fixtures__/organization/sso, so no golden is claimed on this production path and none is invented.
